environment.machine: Apple M4 x10, 16 GiB, darwin 27.2.0 arm64

open-known.method: Same context. Each session is opened once (discarded), then reloaded; "navigations" go to the session by URL from another session.

open-fresh.method: Same context; localStorage, IndexedDB and cache storage of the origin are cleared before each open (the HTTP cache of scripts stays warm).

send-resident.method: Type a tiny prompt, press Enter. start = Enter. sendingShownMs: first delivery state or new message in the page; acceptedMs: the new message with no pending delivery state; turnFinishedMs: assistant reply and Ready. Codex gets one tiny turn just before, so its runtime is loaded.

open-cold-context.method: One new context (cold HTTP cache, new sign-in) per sample.
